rules.name: release_only_beneficiary
rules.why: only the beneficiary may release

rules.name: cancel_only_creator
rules.why: only the creator may cancel

rules.name: cancel_not_closed
rules.why: a closed lock cannot be cancelled again

rules.name: create_bad_params
rules.why: amount, duration and beneficiary must be nonzero

rules.name: create_pulls_amount
rules.why: createLock takes in exactly amount tokens

rules.name: create_id_step
rules.why: each lock gets a new id

rules.name: nextLockId_monotone
rules.why: ids never reused

rules.name: totalShares_in_sync_locks
rules.why: total shares equals sum of open lock shares

rules.name: create_shares_match_total
rules.expr: ok and called("createLock") and post("totalShares") - pre("totalShares") != post("locks", pre("nextLockId"), "shares")
rules.why: new lock shares are exactly what is added to totalShares

rules.name: create_records_lock
rules.expr: ok and called("createLock") and (post("locks", pre("nextLockId"), "beneficiary") != arg(0) or post("locks", pre("nextLockId"), "creator") != sender or post("locks", pre("nextLockId"), "sharesDeposited") != post("locks", pre("nextLockId"), "shares") or post("locks", pre("nextLockId"), "end") != now + arg(2))
rules.why: lock stored as requested

rules.name: share_price_monotone
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalShares") > 0 and post("totalShares") > 0 and wide(post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalShares")) < wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(post("totalShares"))
rules.why: tokens per share never drop for remaining holders (rounding favours pool)

rules.name: release_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("release") and wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalShares")) > wide(post("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn") - pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn")) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0))
rules.why: release pays at most the released shares' fraction of the pool

rules.name: release_shares_in_sync
rules.expr: ok and called("release") and pre("totalShares") - post("totalShares") != post("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn") - pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn")
rules.why: released shares leave totalShares exactly

rules.name: release_updates_lock_shares
rules.expr: ok and called("release") and pre("locks", arg(0), "shares") - post("locks", arg(0), "shares") != post("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn") - pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn")
rules.why: remaining shares of the lock drop by what was released

rules.name: release_vesting_bound
rules.expr: ok and called("release") and now < pre("locks", arg(0), "end") and now > pre("locks", arg(0), "start") and wide(post("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn")) * wide(pre("locks", arg(0), "end") - pre("locks", arg(0), "start")) > wide(pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesDeposited")) * wide(now - pre("locks", arg(0), "start"))
rules.why: cannot withdraw more than vested by time

rules.name: release_before_start_fails
rules.expr: ok and called("release") and now <= pre("locks", arg(0), "start")
rules.why: nothing is vested at start

rules.name: release_withdrawn_bounded
rules.expr: ok and called("release") and post("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn") > pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesDeposited")
rules.why: never withdraw more than deposited

rules.name: cancel_shares_removed
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and pre("totalShares") - post("totalShares") != pre("locks", arg(0), "shares")
rules.why: cancel removes exactly the lock's remaining shares

rules.name: cancel_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalShares")) > wide(pre("locks", arg(0), "shares")) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0))
rules.why: cancel pays out at most the lock's remaining fraction

rules.name: cancel_closes
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and (post("locks", arg(0), "shares") != 0 or post("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn") != post("locks", arg(0), "sharesDeposited"))
rules.why: cancel closes the lock

rules.name: no_third_party_token_loss
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: nobody loses tokens in a call they did not make

rules.name: pool_tokens_only_via_release_cancel
rules.expr: ok and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) and not called("release") and not called("cancel")
rules.why: pool tokens leave only through release/cancel

rules.name: token_ledger
rules.why: token balances sum to supply

rules.name: token_allowance_spent
rules.why: transferFrom consumes allowance

invariants.name: totalShares_eq_sum
invariants.why: total equals sum of lock shares

invariants.name: lock_shares_consistent
invariants.expr: post("locks", u, "shares") + post("locks", u, "sharesWithdrawn") != post("locks", u, "sharesDeposited")

invariants.name: shares_backed
invariants.why: outstanding shares are backed by tokens
